method: Historical mechanical steelhead replay using White River near Whitehall, MI — Fruitvale Road USGS 04122200 daily mean discharge, South Branch White River at Weaver Street Monitor My Watershed series 5989 daily median measured water temperature, and each four-hour block's Open-Meteo radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to This read combines Fruitvale Road flow, measured water temperature below Hesperia Dam, and Pines Point weather as complementary conditions for the below-Hesperia corridor. The sensors are in different reaches, so verify conditions at the water you fish. It validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
